FALSE: a drunk passenger, a valid licence from your foreign country of residence, wrong tyres (vehicle problem), every points loss, no registration document or ownership certificate on board.

q24589.en: A licence revision can be ordered when there are doubts that the driver still has the required physical and mental requirements.

explain.short: A revision checks again that you are fit to drive. Doubts about your health are a typical reason.
explain.rule: 'Revisione' of the licence = a new medical check and/or a new driving exam. The Motorizzazione civile (transport office) or the Prefetto orders it when there are doubts about your physical, mental or technical fitness: after a crash with serious injuries, after drunk or drugged driving, and always when your points reach zero. If you fail it, the licence is revoked. FALSE: moral requirements, permanent loss (that is revocation), vehicle problems or documents, licence left at home, retakes with a special permit.
explain.trap: 'dubbi' (doubts): revision is to check, when things are not sure.

explain.trap: 'autorizzazione scritta' (written permission): not required to drive.

q24603.en: A licence revision is ordered when it is found that the driver is driving without carrying the licence.

explain.short: Forgetting the licence at home means a fine; you show it later. It is not a revision case.
explain.rule: 'Revisione' of the licence = a new medical check and/or a new driving exam. The Motorizzazione civile (transport office) or the Prefetto orders it when there are doubts about your physical, mental or technical fitness: after a crash with serious injuries, after drunk or drugged driving, and always when your points reach zero. If you fail it, the licence is revoked. FALSE: moral requirements, permanent loss (that is revocation), vehicle problems or documents, licence left at home, retakes with a special permit.
explain.trap: 'senza aver con sé' (without carrying): you have a licence, you just forgot it.

sceneParams.caption: Licence left at home: fine, no revision

q24604.en: A driver who fails the licence revision exam can retake it two more times within a year, while continuing to drive with a special permit issued by the Motorizzazione civile.

explain.short: Failing the revision leads to revocation. There are no extra tries and no special permit to keep driving.
explain.rule: 'Revisione' of the licence = a new medical check and/or a new driving exam. The Motorizzazione civile (transport office) or the Prefetto orders it when there are doubts about your physical, mental or technical fitness: after a crash with serious injuries, after drunk or drugged driving, and always when your points reach zero. If you fail it, the licence is revoked. FALSE: moral requirements, permanent loss (that is revocation), vehicle problems or documents, licence left at home, retakes with a special permit.
explain.trap: 'può ripeterlo altre due volte' (can retake it twice): invented; the licence is revoked.

sceneParams.caption: Failed revision: revocation, no retakes

q24605.en: Licence revocation is ordered when the holder drives even though the licence is suspended.

explain.short: Driving during a suspension is very serious: the licence is cancelled.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'nonostante abbia la patente sospesa' (even though suspended): this leads to 'revoca' (revocation).

sceneParams.caption: Driving while suspended: licence revoked

q24606.en: Licence revocation can be ordered when the driver, on a motorway, makes a U-turn or drives on the carriageway against the traffic.

explain.short: Turning round or driving the wrong way on a motorway is extremely dangerous, so the licence can be revoked.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'contro mano' (the wrong way): one of the most serious motorway offences.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong way on a motorway: revocation possible

q24607.en: Licence revocation is ordered when the holder permanently (for ever) loses the required physical requirements.

explain.short: If you will never again be physically fit to drive, the licence is cancelled.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'permanentemente' (for ever) = revocation; 'temporaneamente' (for a time) = suspension.

sceneParams.caption: Physical fitness lost for ever: revoked

q24608.en: Licence revocation is ordered when the holder permanently (for ever) loses the required mental requirements.

explain.short: If you will never again be mentally fit to drive, the licence is cancelled.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'permanentemente' (for ever) = revocation; a temporary problem = suspension.

sceneParams.caption: Mental fitness lost for ever: revoked

q24609.en: Licence revocation is ordered when the licence itself is replaced by another one issued by a foreign country.

explain.short: You cannot hold two licences. When a foreign country gives you its licence in exchange, the Italian one is revoked.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'sostituita' (replaced): the Italian licence ends because you now have the foreign one.

sceneParams.caption: Swapped for a foreign licence: revoked

q24610.en: Licence revocation is ordered when the holder, after a revision exam, is found to be no longer fit to drive.

explain.short: Failing the revision means you are not fit: the licence is revoked.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'non risulti più idoneo' (is no longer fit): that is the revocation case.

sceneParams.caption: Not fit at revision: licence revoked

q24611.en: Licence revocation is ordered when the driver drives with an expired licence.

explain.short: An expired licence is withdrawn and you get a fine; after renewal you get it back. It is not revoked.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'scaduta' (expired) = withdrawal ('ritiro'), not revocation.

sceneParams.caption: Expired licence: withdrawal, not revocation
lines: Renew it and get it back

q24612.en: Licence revocation can be ordered when the driver drives without carrying it.

explain.short: Forgetting the licence at home only means a fine. You still have a valid licence.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'senza averla con sé' (without carrying it): a small offence.

sceneParams.caption: Licence left at home: just a fine

q24613.en: Licence revocation is ordered when the driver temporarily loses the physical requirements.

explain.short: A temporary problem means suspension, until you are fit again. Revocation is for a permanent loss.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'temporaneamente' (for a time) = suspension, not revocation.

sceneParams.caption: Temporary loss: suspension, not revocation

q24614.en: Licence revocation can be ordered when the driver drives without the corrective lenses that are required.

explain.short: Driving without the required glasses is an offence with a fine, not a reason for revocation.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'lenti correttive' (glasses or contact lenses): forgetting them means a fine.

sceneParams.caption: No glasses: fine, not revocation

q24615.en: Licence revocation can be ordered by the police.

explain.short: The police can withdraw a licence on the road, but revocation is ordered by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'organi di polizia' (police): they take the licence, they do not revoke it.

sceneParams.caption: Revocation: Motorizzazione or Prefetto, not police

q24616.en: Licence revocation can be ordered when the driver drives a vehicle registered to another person without a written declaration.

explain.short: You may drive a car registered to someone else; no written declaration is needed, and it is not a reason for revocation.
explain.rule: 'Revoca' = the licence is cancelled; you need a new one. It is ordered (by the Motorizzazione civile or the Prefetto, not the police) when you drive while suspended, lose physical or mental fitness for ever, fail a revision exam, or swap it for a foreign licence; it can also follow a U-turn or wrong-way driving on a motorway. FALSE: expired licence (withdrawal), licence left at home, temporary health problems (suspension), no glasses, driving someone else's car.
explain.trap: 'intestato ad altra persona' (registered to another person): allowed with the owner's consent.

sceneParams.caption: Car of someone else: no revocation
